decisions.reason: Quantified customer savings indicate performance above aspiration, and in a growing firm with slack and strong fit to the core portfolio management would continue the product.
As a flagship modular line central to the firm's stated direction, it would be retained unless results clearly fell below aspiration, which is not evident.
Market signals are weaker than for the flagship products, but its close fit to the established business and the firm's growth and slack make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

This newly launched multi-model shredder line appears to absorb resources from the earlier withdrawn shredder and, despite still-uncertain results, would likely be kept while management learns from the market.
The new screen line builds on existing capabilities and strategic direction, so with organizational slack and no visible underperformance management would normally give it more time.
